name: Chicken Tortilla Soup

ingredients.item: shredded cheese, sour cream, tortilla strips

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Saute onion 5 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, and chili powder, cook 1 minute.
Add chicken breasts, broth, enchilada sauce, beans, and corn.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return to pot.
Simmer 5 more minutes. Season with salt.
Serve topped with shredded cheese, sour cream, and tortilla strips.

substitutions.dairy_free: Skip cheese and sour cream toppings.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use gluten-free enchilada sauce and tortilla strips.
substitutions.vegetarian: Replace chicken with an extra can of beans and use vegetable broth.
